rows.commentary: 0.3: Brad Evans delivers a fullish ball that pitches just outside off, moving away late and beating Mohammad Akram on the back foot.
0.4: Brad Evans bowls a wide, back of a length outside off, and Akram flashes hard but misses it.
0.4: Brad Evans bowls a short delivery to Mohammad Akram, who pulls it and is caught by Vincent Masekesa in the deep.
0.5: Brad Evans bowls a back of a length outside off to Sediqullah Atal, who stands tall and punches it through the off‑side, but the fielder at covers stops it.
0.6: Brad Evans delivers a slightly shorter outside off to Atal, who mistimes a cut to point, leaving the ball at cover.
1.1: Masuku bowls a good length, angling into Ibrahim Zadran, who defends it behind the line.
1.2: Masuku offers a back of a length with a hint of width to Zadran, who punches it towards covers but a fumble in the field prevents a run.
1.3: Masuku bowls a short, wide ball that finds Zadran’s bat for a creamed square cut, but it is intercepted by the infielder.
1.4: Masuku bowls a fraction short outside off to Zadran, who forces it off the back foot towards mid‑off.
1.5: Masuku bowls a bit full outside off, and Zadran goes hard, edging it to third man for one run.
1.6: Masuku offers a length outside off angling across to Atal, who attempts a loose drive but misses as the ball goes under his bat.
2.1: Brad Evans bowls a full ball tailing in to Ibrahim Zadran, who chips it in the air towards mid‑on.
2.2: Brad Evans delivers a ball pitched up and in the slot to Ibrahim Zadran, who creams it on the up towards covers, and the fielder makes an excellent stop.
2.3: Brad Evans sends a leg‑by‑leg delivery to Ibrahim Zadran, who misses it and the ball rolls off his pads for a single.
2.4: Brad Evans zeroes in on the channel outside off, pinning Sediqullah Atal down who drives it toward the cover ring before immediately aborting the run.
2.5: Brad Evans bowls a length ball to Sediqullah Atal, who nudges it to deep extra cover for two runs.
10.3: Ryan Burl sends a flatter, shorter ball, and Ahmadzai cuts it to backward point for a single.
10.4: Ryan Burl bowls a short, middle delivery, and Omarzai rocks back to pull it into the stands over deep mid‑wicket for a six.
10.5: Ryan Burl tosses a ball up on off, and Omarzai drives it down to long‑off for a single.
10.6: Ryan Burl delivers a full ball on middle, and Ahmadzai eases it to long‑on for a single.
11.1: Sikandar Raza sends a floated ball up the pitch, and Ahmadzai knocks it down to long‑on for a single.
11.2: Sikandar Raza bowls a short ball, and Azmatullah Omarzai mistimes a pull, letting it fall short of deep mid‑wicket.
11.3: Sikandar Raza delivers a shorter, quicker ball, and Ahmadzai cuts it late to deep backward point, saving the extra runs.
11.4: Sikandar Raza sends a full, turning ball into the fine leg, and Ahmadzai sweeps it toward backward square leg, only for the fielder to miss the awkward bounce.
11.5: Sikandar Raza unleashes a thumping six that sails straight to the stands, the ball turning sharply and Ahmadzai kneeling to sweep it over deep mid‑wicket with fierce disdain.
11.6: Sikandar Raza bowls a quicker, fuller delivery outside off, and Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai attempts a drive that clips an inside edge toward short mid-wicket, leaving a crisp gap.
12.1: Masuku bowls a full ball to Azmatullah Omarzai, who drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
12.2: Masuku bowls a short bouncer to Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai, who swivels and pulls a SIX over fine leg.
12.3: Masuku bowls a back‑of‑a‑length ball, and Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai defends it to the leg‑side, no run.
12.4: Masuku bowls a slightly shorter ball, and Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai swings wildly, connecting only to thin air.
12.5: Masuku bowls to Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai, who taps it to covers for a single, but the ball is returned.
12.6: Masuku drifts it full outside off, and Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai opens the face to carve a gorgeous square drive past the diving fielder for four.
13.1: Vincent Masekesa bowls to Azmatullah Omarzai, who swings wide, misses the ball entirely.
13.2: Vincent Masekesa unleashes a SIX to long‑on, sending Azmatullah Omarzai and Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai’s partnership soaring.
1.4: Azmatullah Omarzai bowls a full‑on off‑length delivery to Innocent Kaia, who forwards and hacks it over mid‑wicket, while Rashid from mid‑on sprints and slides to save the four.
1.5: Azmatullah Omarzai unleashes a bazooka inswinger to Innocent Kaia, who crams the short‑length ball into the pads after attempting a cut.
1.6: Azmatullah Omarzai sends a full‑outside off ball to Innocent Kaia, who drives it through the line and smashes it to the right of mid‑off for a four.
2.1: Mujeeb Ur Rahman launches a towering sweep off a full toss outside off, sending it sailing over deep backward square‑leg for a sensational six.
2.2: Mujeeb Ur Rahman bowls a tossed‑up googly to Brian Bennett, who drives it forward and the thick inside edge narrowly misses the stumps for a single.
2.3: Mujeeb Ur Rahman tosses a full‑outside off to Innocent Kaia, who attempts a slogsweep but misses.
2.4: Mujeeb Ur Rahman delivers a googly on good length off to Innocent Kaia, who pulls it to long‑on for a single.
2.5: Mujeeb Ur Rahman bowls an off‑break short of length outside off to Brian Bennett, who slashes on the bounce to short third man.
2.6: Mujeeb Ur Rahman tosses a full‑outside off to Brian Bennett, who drives straight to the fielder at extra‑cover.
3.1: Azmatullah Omarzai bowls a slower‑ball full on the stumps to Innocent Kaia, who backs away, lofts it over point, and clears the off‑side infield.
3.2: Azmatullah Omarzai delivers a slower‑ball on a good length off to Innocent Kaia, who forwards and lofts it over mid‑on for a four.
3.3: Azmatullah Omarzai bowls a short ball to Innocent Kaia, who pulls it and the top‑edge rises straight up to be caught by Shahidullah Kamal in deep backward square‑leg.
3.4: Azmatullah Omarzai angles a length ball into middle and leg, allowing Sikandar Raza to flick it toward deep mid-wicket to get off the mark.
3.5: Azmatullah Omarzai tails a clever slower delivery as Brian Bennett makes room, punching it smartly wide of mid-off for a single.
3.6: Azmatullah Omarzai slips in a clever slower ball outside off, prompting Sikandar Raza to check his defensive push toward the bowler.
4.1: Mujeeb Ur Rahman tosses it up to Brian Bennett, who works a single into the deep mid-wicket pocket.
13.4: Abdullah Ahmadzai serves it full and wide, prompting Tafadzwa Tsiga to unleash a hard drive square to the sweeper on the off-side.
13.5: Abdullah Ahmadzai delivers a searing inswinging yorker onto middle-stump, which Sikandar Raza digs out toward the vacant mid-wicket region to scramble back for a sharp second.
13.6: Abdullah Ahmadzai floats a full, slower-ball off-cutter outside off, allowing Sikandar Raza to lean back and guide it toward sweeper cover.
14.1: Mujeeb Ur Rahman tracks Sikandar Raza as the batter backs away against a full delivery outside leg, nudging it toward the right of extra-cover.
14.2: Mujeeb Ur Rahman pitches it on middle as Sikandar Raza steps away to clatter a monstrous shot over deep mid-wicket, sealing his eighteenth T20I fifty.
14.3: Mujeeb Ur Rahman drops a low-skidding googly outside off that keeps slightly low, slipping past Sikandar Raza's attempted pull.
14.4: Mujeeb Ur Rahman drifts another turning googly into off, catching Sikandar Raza's thick inside edge as he swings from the back foot toward the open mid-wicket expanse.
14.5: Mujeeb Ur Rahman fires a brisk delivery straight onto middle-stump, met by Tafadzwa Tsiga stepping forward to stroke it toward long-on.
14.6: Mujeeb Ur Rahman misses his yorker with a low full-toss outside off, which Sikandar Raza deftly guides past short third man to bring up the fifty-run partnership.
15.1: Abdullah Ahmadzai drops an inviting low full-toss on middle, inviting Tafadzwa Tsiga to drop low and scoop it cleanly over short fine leg.
15.2: Abdullah Ahmadzai delivers a full-toss on leg-stump that Tafadzwa Tsiga mistimes back down the pitch, prompting a hasty gear change as the battered willow requires replacing.
15.3: Abdullah Ahmadzai misses his mark with a dipping low full-toss, allowing Tafadzwa Tsiga to harness his new bat and launch it deep into the stands over mid-wicket.
15.4: Abdullah Ahmadzai serves a low full-toss on middle, pushed by Tafadzwa Tsiga toward mid-off where Ibrahim fumbles the charge, allowing a single.
15.5: Abdullah Ahmadzai pushes a full delivery just outside off past Sikandar Raza, who steps forward looking to heave leg-side but swings completely into empty air.
15.6: Abdullah Ahmadzai rolls out a slower-ball off-cutter on a length outside off, miscued off the front foot by Sikandar Raza as it dribbles toward long-on for a single.
16.1: Rashid Khan gets launched into the night sky by Sikandar Raza, depositing the ball deep over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.
18.1: Shahidullah Kamal drops it flat on a good length, and Tafadzwa Tsiga steps back to pull it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
18.2: Shahidullah Kamal fires in a back-of-a-length delivery, and Sikandar Raza tries to get forward and loft it, only to mistime it straight to deep extra-cover and refuse the run.
18.3: Shahidullah Kamal sprays this one miles wide of off stump, allowing Sikandar Raza to watch it sail past.
18.3: Shahidullah Kamal fires it flat on a good length, right on the tramline, and Sikandar Raza can only watch the umpire wave away his appeals after shouldering arms.
18.4: Shahidullah Kamal attacks the length outside off, and Sikandar Raza pushes forward to miscues a lofted shot on the bounce toward deep extra-cover before scampering across for a single.
18.5: Shahidullah Kamal digs a flat, pitch-straining length delivery outside off, and Tafadzwa Tsiga reaches forward to force it wide of long-off.
18.6: Shahidullah Kamal floats a good-length ball around off, and Sikandar Raza anchors deep in his crease to pull it over the deep square leg fence, bringing up the team's century partnership.
19.1: Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai pushes a very full delivery outside off, and Tafadzwa Tsiga gets forward to drive it firmly toward sweeper cover.
19.2: Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai loses his radar completely, spearing a wide delivery so far outside off it barely stays on the cutstrip.
19.2: Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai serves up a full delivery right in the slot, and Sikandar Raza drops onto his back knee to launch it clean over the roof at long-on and out of the ground entirely.

19.3: Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai tosses up a low full-toss that Sikandar Raza drives to deep extra-cover to reach a magnificent T20I century, met with a warm embrace from Tafadzwa Tsiga and a quiet raising of the bat to the dugout.
19.4: Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai lands it very full outside off, and Tafadzwa Tsiga gets forward to punch his drive out toward long-on.
19.5: Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai fires in a low full-toss outside off, and Sikandar Raza swings hard for the leg side only to feel thin air.
19.6: Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai serves it full outside off, and Sikandar Raza drops to one knee to launch it miles over deep backward square-leg and onto the roof.
